title: rbioanp: A Comprehensive Biodiversity and Biogeographic Database of Peru's State-Protected Natural Areas
text: Peru recognized one world’s 17 megadiverse countries, harboring exceptional levels species richness, endemism, ecosystem diversity. National System State-Protected Natural Areas (Sistema Nacional de Áreas Naturales Protegidas por el Estado - SINANPE), managed National Service Natural Protected Areas (Servicio Nacional de Áreas Naturales Protegidas por el Estado - SERNANP), covers 30 million hectares across terrestrial, Andean, Amazonian, marine-coastal biomes. Data Paper presents rbioanp, R package consolidates, standardizes, enriches curated biodiversity datasets Peru’s protected areas available via bioANP platform. package integrates five primary datasets encompassing: Spatial administrative metadata 287 Protected Natural Areas (ANPs). taxonomic inventory 12,052 flora species standardized according Angiosperm Phylogeny Group (APG) classification. taxonomic inventory 6,420 fauna species (vertebrates invertebrates) aligned international taxonomic databases. occurrence database containing 55,155 species occurrence records across 75 protected areas, complete national endemism threat status flags. global biogeographic distribution database 183,558 records mapped using World Geographic Scheme Recording Plant Distributions (WGSRPD Level 3) standard via wcvpmatch World Checklist Vascular Plants (WCVP).

title: rbioanp: A Comprehensive Biodiversity and Biogeographic Database of Peru's State-Protected Natural Areas
text: Peru’s protected areas form cornerstone biodiversity conservation Tropical Andes Amazon basin. However, accessing, harmonizing, analyzing official biodiversity monitoring datasets protected areas historically presented technical challenges due fragmented data sources, non-standardized taxonomy, varying administrative reporting formats. rbioanp package bridges gap providing R-native ecosystem biodiversity informatics, macroecology, conservation decision-making Peru.

title: rbioanp: A Comprehensive Biodiversity and Biogeographic Database of Peru's State-Protected Natural Areas
text: Analyzing 55,155 occurrence records reveals key hotspots endemic threatened species. Table 5. Top 5 protected natural areas highest occurrence record density.
code:
data(anp_species_occ)  # Summary of endemism and threat status total_occ <- nrow(anp_species_occ) endemic_count <- sum(anp_species_occ$endemica == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE) threatened_count <- sum(anp_species_occ$amenazada == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE) both_count <- sum(anp_species_occ$endemica == TRUE & anp_species_occ$amenazada == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)  cat("Total Occurrence Records:", total_occ, "
") #> Total Occurrence Records: 55155 cat("Endemic Species Occurrences:", endemic_count, sprintf("(%.2f%%)
", 100 * endemic_count / total_occ)) #> Endemic Species Occurrences: 2432 (4.41%) cat("Threatened Species Occurrences:", threatened_count, sprintf("(%.2f%%)
", 100 * threatened_count / total_occ)) #> Threatened Species Occurrences: 1601 (2.90%) cat("Both Endemic & Threatened Occurrences:", both_count, "
") #> Both Endemic & Threatened Occurrences: 276  # Top 5 ANPs by occurrence richness top_anps <- anp_species_occ %>%   count(anp_nombre, sort = TRUE) %>%   head(5)  knitr::kable(top_anps, col.names = c("Protected Natural Area", "Record Count"),              caption = "Table 5. Top 5 protected natural areas with the highest occurrence record density.")

Top 10 botanical areas sharing native flora species with Peruvian ANPs.")

Biogeographic Cross-referencing: Global distributions linked using World Geographic Scheme Recording Plant Distributions (WGSRPD Level 3) standard. text: tibble 287 rows 13 variables: categoria Character. Category protected area (e.g., "PARQUES NACIONALES", "RESERVAS NACIONALES", "SANTUARIOS NACIONALES"). Represents IUCN management category adapted Peruvian legislation. codigo Character. Primary identification code protected area, typically consisting category abbreviation sequential number (e.g., "PN 01" first National Park). nombre Character. Official name protected area. codigo_2 Character. Secondary identification code, applicable. Contains NA entries. nombre_2 Character. Secondary alternative name, applicable. Contains NA entries. base_legal_creacion Character. Legal instrument established protected area (e.g., "LEY 13694", "D.S. 644-1973-AG"). May include laws (LEY), supreme decrees (D.S.), legal documents. fecha_promulgacion_creacion Date. Promulgation date legal instrument created protected area, YYYY-MM-DD format. base_legal_modificacion Character. Legal instrument(s) modified original protected area designation, . May contain multiple references separated semicolons. Contains NA modifications exist. fecha_promulgacion_modificacion Character. Promulgation date(s) modification legal instruments. May contain multiple dates separated slashes multiple modifications. Contains NA modifications exist. ubicacion_politica Character. Political-administrative location protected area, listing department(s) located. Multiple departments separated commas "y" (). extension_ha Numeric. Total area protected area hectares. fuente Character. Data source, typically "SERNANP" (Servicio Nacional de Áreas Naturales Protegidas por el Estado). version Character. Version date official list DD-MM-YYYY format.
